content:
incident-bot: P1 - cross-region failover anomalies detected during automatic failover from ap-northeast-1 to us-east-1. Symptoms: user session reconnect loops and increased 5xx on routing tier. Paging @lee (primary oncall) and @anita (secondary).

lee: acknowledging. quick symptom dump please (regions, services affected)?

fernando: Grafana spike at 2026-07-02T09:03:12Z. 502/503 on /v1/session and /realtime/ws. 60% of erroring requests originated from ap-northeast-1 edge nodes. Link: https://graf.prod/redwood/alerts/67890

anita: healthchecks are failing for app-pool in ap-northeast-1 but LB still shows pool as eligible due to incorrect draining credits. Edge proxies cached origin resolution pointing to ap-northeast-1; some clients rapidly reconnected and hit failed nodes, producing reconnect loops.

lee: suspected root cause options: 1) DNS TTL not lowered before shift so some resolvers pick stale ap-northeast IPs; 2) edge cache eviction not honored causing split-horizon; 3) drain logic keeps bouncing connections (drain<->active). Mitigation plan?

ops-bot: auto-runbooks triggered: failover->regional-shift, notify-cs.

anita: immediate mitigations I propose: A) emergency origin override at edge (force origin us-east-1 for api.redwood.com) B) conn-sweep older-than 30s in ap-northeast-1, C) increase route propagation priority for us-east-1. Also cancel any in-flight model deployments in ap-northeast-1.

lee: agree. Fernando take edge override. Anita do conn-sweep and cache flush. I'll cancel deploys. CS liaison prepare external message.

deploy-bot: Canceling model rollout: rollout-20260702-apne1-3 (in-progress).

fernando: executing edge override now:
```
$ edgectl origin-override --host api.redwood.com --force-origin us-east-1
Applying override to global POPs... ok
POP report: 92% honored override, 8% serving stale mapping (inconsistent caches)
```

fernando: note: some legacy POPs have long-lived mappings due to third-party CDN caches. We're sending purge requests but those are best-effort.

anita: running conn-sweep:
```
$ infractl conn-sweep --region ap-northeast-1 --min-age 30s
Found 1,120 open sessions matching filter; initiating graceful close
Closed 1,120 sessions
```

anita: flushing internal route cache for edges in ap-northeast-1:
```
$ infractl cache-invalidate --scope edge --region ap-northeast-1 --key api.redwood.com
Invalidated 58 POP caches
```

lee: after actions, 5xx has dropped from 18% -> 4% within 90s. Some customers report reconnect and then immediate failure -> those were hitting stubborn POPs. Fernando can you run purge on CDN partner?

fernando: pinging partner support. Purge request id: PURGE-7732. They report in-queue; estimate 2-5m. Continuing to monitor.

cs-liaison: drafting external message: "We are investigating session reconnects for customers in AP region. Traffic is redirected to a healthy region; you may experience transient reconnects. We'll update in 15 minutes." Publish?

lee: publish minimal note with 15m cadence. Add workaround: restart client session if repeated failure.

neteng-bot: Observed BGP flap in ap-northeast-1 at 09:01Z causing partial reachability issues; some edge nodes failed healthchecks temporarily. Trace sample: AS2856 -> AS64512 path reset.

anita: also found a bug in drain-state machine where websocket sessions toggled drain->active when origin health-check toggled, causing some sessions to be re-routed back to bad AZ. We'll capture logs for RCA.

lee: handoff: I've got a meeting at 09:10Z, anita you'll take lead. Record handoff.

ops-bot: Handoff logged: lee -> anita at 2026-07-02T09:09:50Z.

anita: oncall lead. Current state: edge override in place, conn-sweep completed, caches partially invalidated, CDN purge pending. Traffic to us-east-1 ~88%. 5xx ~3.8%. Monitoring for 20 minutes before closure.

fernando: partner purge completed at 09:12Z. POP report now shows 99% honor override.

lee: back online at 09:18Z. great work. any customers still affected? cs-liaison?

cs-liaison: two enterprise customers reported repeated reconnects but both confirm sessions recovered after client restart. Sent follow-up notes.

anita: timeline/next steps for RCA: 1) collect edge POP logs and drain-state traces 2) add TTL-change step to failover runbook (lower to 30s before shift) 3) fix drain FSM bug for websocket sessions 4) add active check to ensure CDN caches accept purge (retry/backoff). Assign owners?

lee: assign 1) fernando (neteng) 2) infra-owner (tbd) for TTL/runbook change 3) eng-runtime for drain FSM 4) infra for CDN purge automation. Create ENG-INC ticket.

incident-bot: Incident moved to mitigated state by anita at 2026-07-02T09:25:00Z. Creating follow-up: ENG-INC-20260702-002 (RCA + action items).

anita: publishing resolution update to status page: "Issue mitigated; traffic shifted and caches purged. Root cause: regional network instability + drain-state bug. RCA forthcoming."

cs-liaison: posted customer resolution note. Customers acknowledged.

lee: closing ops loop. thanks team. Please attach all logs to ENG-INC-20260702-002 and schedule RCA meeting.

anita: will run retention and attach packet captures. Leaving thread open for RCA doc links. :white_check_mark:
